content: Moonlight and Parsec both expose live stream diagnostics rather than relying on subjective smoothness. Expected fields include actual resolution and frame rate, codec and chroma, bitrate, encoder and decoder type, encode and decode latency, network RTT and jitter or congestion, queue and render latency, and dropped frames classified by cause. Moonlight also warns that app telemetry omits compositor, display, and device latency, so input-to-photon claims need external measurement. Sources: https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-docs/wiki/Frequently-Asked-Questions and https://support.parsec.app/hc/en-us/articles/32381603663636-Stream-Overlay-Stats-and-Logging.
